anilist.description:
The anime's story is set in the late 1950s and early 1960s, during the height of Japan's economic boom, when the circus is a major form of entertainment. Different circus troupes travel throughout Japan to perform and compete for a chance to participate in the world-renowned festival called "Circus Collection." One troupe called the "Sunflower Circus," led by its ringmaster Maria, travels around Japan to perform, despite struggling with financial difficulties. However, they meet a circus prodigy named Mizuka Tsurumaki. This is the story of a one-of-a-kind circus show of young girls with big dreams.

(Source: Anime News Network)

schedule.description:
In Japan during the height of its economic boom in the mid-1950s, the circus was a form of entertainment that became a central part of many people's lives. The best troupes are permitted to participate in the world-renowned "Circus Collection" festival, and many come from all over Japan to compete daily.

The story centers on the struggling "Sunflower Circus" troupe, led by ringmaster Maria, and a new prodigy that joins their ranks for unknown reasons: Mizuka Tsurumaki.

Is her encounter with the highly individual members of the Sunflower Circus troupe a coincidence or destiny? This one-of-a-kind circus show depicting young girls chasing their dreams begins!

(Source: Official site, translated)

episodes.title: Welcome to the Sunflower Circus!

titles.ja: ようこそ, ひまわりサーカスへ!

episodes.overview: In 1950s Japan, penniless Mizuka meets two circus girls, sparking a dream-filled new beginning.

episodes.title: That Was So Dazzling

titles.ja: それはとっても, 眩しくて

episodes.overview: The "Sunflower Circus" is headed to Toyokawa, a popular and officially sanctioned performance venue.

episodes.title: I Don`t Want to Show My Scars

titles.ja: 傷跡なんか, 見せたくない
titles.en: I Don`t Want to Show My Scars

episodes.overview: Determined to surpass "Shiny Lavender", the "Sunflower Circus" prepares for its upcoming show.

episodes.title: I Just Can`t Bring Myself to Be Honest

titles.ja: 素直になんか, なれなくて
titles.en: I Just Can`t Bring Myself to Be Honest

episodes.overview: The "Sunflower Circus" had a successful show in Toyokawa, but their earnings were seized by debt collectors.

episodes.title: There Is Nowhere I Belong

titles.ja: 居場所なんか, どこにもない
titles.x-jat: Ibasho Nanka, Doko ni mo Nai

episodes.overview: Akane storms off as Mizuka searches the mountains for Rafflesia Circus’s missing François.

episodes.title: A Sinister Legend Summons a Storm

titles.ja: 忌まわしき伝説, 嵐を呼んで
titles.en: A Sinister Legend Summons a Storm

episodes.overview: Nanami Sumeragi’s team makes headlines with newspapers asking if they could surpass the "Lotus Circus."

episodes.title: I Don`t Get the Circus

titles.ja: サーカスが, わからない

episodes.overview: Mizuka, determined to challenge Mitscher, returns to the group members who all look very serious.

episodes.title: This Is What I Always Wanted

titles.ja: それはずっと, ほしかったもの
titles.en: This Is What I Always Wanted

episodes.overview: With the Sumeragi Group’s elite troupe, the "Blue Rose Circus," nearby, the "Sunflower Circus" faces a predictably poor turnout for its next performance. Mizuka, having resolves to take the stage as a performer, nervously peeks out at the audience. After confiding her anxiety to Ouka in the wings, she trusts Ouka's advice—"look at the audience before you fly"—and Mizuka steps onto the trapeze.

episodes.title: Is All That Kindness Just a Lie?

titles.ja: その優しさは, ぜんぶ嘘?
titles.en: Is All That Kindness Just a Lie?

episodes.overview: Maria collapses from exhaustion, and Rin fiercely scolds the troupe for causing chaos at the hospital.

episodes.title: Beyond the Stage of Dreams

titles.ja: 夢の舞台, その向こう側へ
titles.x-jat: Yume no Butai, Sono Mukougawa e

episodes.overview: The "Sunflower Circus" has been granted permission to participate in the "Circus Collection Japan Tournament."

episodes.title: For Whose Sake Is This Unfulfilled Dream?

titles.ja: 見果てぬ夢は, 誰がために?
titles.en: For Whose Sake Is This Unfulfilled Dream?
titles.x-jat: Mihatenu Yume wa, Ta ga Tame ni?

episodes.overview: Mizuka and Ouka are unable to hide their growing anxiety, pushing themselves with excessive training.

episodes.title: Where the Heart Resides - Weaving Dreams

titles.ja: 想いの在処, 紡ぐは夢
titles.en: Where the Heart Resides - Weaving Dreams
titles.x-jat: Omoi no Arika, Tsumugu wa Yume

episodes.overview: With surgery in the United States fast approaching, Maria was placed under a strict no-visitor policy.

titles.ja: 特別生配信 「潜入! ひまわりサーカス」
